d:
Presenting the much-awaited video song "Kudi Nu Nachne De" from the bollywood movie . The song is featuring Anushka Sharma, Katrina Kaif, Alia Bhatt, Janhvi Kapoor, Ananya Panday, Kriti Sanon, Kiara Advani, and Radhika Madan. This latest track is sung by Vishal Dadlani and Sachin-Jigar, and the music is composed by Sachin-Jigar.
! In an unprecedented gesture, some of our top B-town actresses have rallied by making a music video that celebrates women & shares their love for Angrezi Medium.
Angrezi Medium releasing 13th March 2020.
